<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Block is SOLID PURPLE! Now:
# 1. Select WHITE cursor
# 2. Position cursor on block center
# 3. Press SPACE → should split to white-top, purple-bottom

# Select white cursor (at rows 3-5, cols 36-38)
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 4, 'col': 37}])
print("Select white:", result.get('board_changed'))

# Position cursor on block center
# Block is at rows 34-43, cols 27-36
# Cursor needs to overlap block center
# Current cursor at rows 40-56, cols 33-49

result = action(['UP', 'UP', 'LEFT', 'LEFT'])
print("Move cursor:", result.get('board_changed'))

# Check cursor position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for node in seg['nodes']:
    if node['color'] == 'g' and node['pixels'] > 20:
        rows = [p[0] for p in node['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in node['boundary']]
        print(f"Cursor: rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, cols {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Press SPACE
result = action(['SPACE'])
print("SPACE:", result.get('board_changed'))

# Check block
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("\nBlock:")
for i in range(34, 44):
    row_str = ascii_lines[i][26:37]
    print(f"  {i}: '{row_str}'")

# Check reference panel
print("\nReference (left panel):")
for i in range(3, 13):
    row_str = ascii_lines[i][2:14]
    print(f"  {i}: '{row_str}'")

# Check if level completed
print(f"\nLevel completed: {result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"Done: {result.get('done')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
